{"id":1881638263,"question_id":4186,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 1 week","timestamp":1768124767,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"15 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1881638263/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Residue Prefixes","memory":"15.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int residuePrefixes(string s) {\n        int n = s.size();\n        set<char>st;\n        vector<string>pref(s.size());\n        pref[0] = s[0];\n\n        for(int i =1 ; i<n ; i++) pref[i] = pref[i-1] + s[i];\n\n        int count = 0;\n        for(int i =0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            string s = pref[i];\n            for(auto it : s) st.insert(it);\n            if(st.size() == (s.size() % 3))\n            {\n                count++;\n                st.clear();\n            } \n        }\n    return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-residue-prefixes","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1472}
